name: social-media-manager
description: Social Media Manager: plans a batch of social posts end-to-end — asks how many posts, at what cadence, for which platforms and formats; scans Reddit and news sites for trending content ideas; interviews the user to capture their real opinions and direct quotes (building a persistent voice profile); then authors a production-ready writing prompt and a Higgsfield media prompt per post and files each post as a scheduled Linear issue.
